programmes.t: The Return Of Hunter: Everyone Walks In L.A.
programmes.d: Rick Hunter's back. He's considering marrying his girlfriend. But before he could, she is murdered.
Son of a mobster, Detective Sergeant Rick Hunter and Sergeant Dee Dee McCall team up to catch a serial killer.
McCall's ex-partner has gone bad. In an attempt to save him from prison, McCall and Hunter try to stop him.
After the Commissioner's wife is murdered, Hunter and McCall piece together the clues to find the true killer.
A meek pick-pocket is accused of beating a woman. Hunter and McCall, unconvinced, must find the true culprit.
Hunter uses a mobster's girlfriend as bait after she overhears an argument between him and his father.
Hunter and McCall help a girl who claims her uncle has died and all of his pigeons have been stolen.
A drug dealer is killed by a thief who stole Hunter's "backup" gun. McCall must clear Hunter's name.
A bounty hunter tracking two bank robbers crosses paths with Hunter and McCall.
Hunter and McCall must protect a sleazy criminal who has been given immunity for fingering a top criminal.
A motorcycle cop is killed by a man on a "nighthawk." The killer motivated by a dispute over a game at a bar.
Hunter and McCall must track down a killer who has been shooting parolees.
A mentally disturbed surveillance expert attempts to "help" Hunter by killing a suspect and a witness.
A cocaine dealer being escorted by an obnoxious detective escapes. Hunter and the detective pursue her.
The pursuit of the cocaine dealer continues and the plot thickens as Hunter and McCall's cases collide.
The Beach Boy arrives in LA and begins to kill drug dealers. Hunter and McCall must figure out his next move.
Hunter and McCall pursue a convicted murderer who is free and has vowed to kill the jurors who convicted him.
A contract killer makes hits throughout the city in order to ingratiate himself with a criminal kingpin.
Someone has been setting fires all over the city to empty warehouse, and Hunter and McCall are on the case.
Hunter and McCall go after a sniper who is killing blondes that remind him of his wife who jilted him.
McCall goes undercover to help Hunter investigate the deaths of two models involved in pornographic films.
Hunter and McCall investigate a Chinese gang leader being pursued by a police officer with a personal interest
Hunter and McCall go undercover at an exclusive resort to find a blackmailer's killer.
A millionaire is nearly killed, his wife the prime suspect, until she's murdered.
Hunter and McCall witness a string of murders when they're assigned as technical advisers for a tv show.
When McCall is raped by a South American diplomat immune from prosecution, Hunter follows him to his homeland.
Against departmental orders, Hunter goes to South America to stalk a diplomat who raped McCall.
Hunter and McCall pursue a security guard turned thief as he searches for the money he stole and lost.
Hunter and McCall realize they're attracted to each other as they protect an endangered witness.
Hunter becomes involved with a beautiful model he suspects of complicity in a jewelry robbery.
Hunter helps a policeman who is framed for the murder of his wife.
Hunter pursues a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to kill the participants in his trial.
Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison
Hunter and McCall are given 72 hours to find an attorney who falsified his death.
When a dying contract killer confesses he was paid to kill Hunter's father, Hunter pursues the true murderer.
A teenager's death leads Hunter and McCall to a Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes.
Hunter and McCall investigate a student terror group in the car bombing of a Middle-Eastern consulate member.
Hunter investigates a theft turned murder when a robbery victim hires a detective to retrieve stolen jewels.
Wrongly suspended from the force for beating a suspect, Hunter pursues the gangster who had him discredited.
When a dead girl disappears from Hunter's living room, he and McCall follow a trail of intrigue and murder.
Hunter and McCall's investigation into adultery and homicide pits them against a group of Russian spies.
Hunter and Dee get a murder case reopened in order to exonerate a paroled ex-boxer and find the real killer.
Hunter and McCall investigate mysterious calls to a reporter about a series of murders.
Hunter attempts to apprehend a vicious robbery suspect while he clashes with a vindictive reporter.
Hunter and McCall must work individually after they are separated as partners by their new precinct leader.
While investigating a homicide, McCall falls in love with the prime suspect - the victim's husband.
Hunter and McCall attempt to break a cocaine syndicate apparently being run by one of Hunter's ex-partners.
Hunter receives a death threat from a quick-tempered foreign official determined to avenge his brother's death
A police detective aids in solving a series of murders connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.
The search for a vengeful woman suspected of murdering two men involved in her sister's cocaine-related death.
Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer.
Hunter and McCall's kidnapping-homicide investigation is thwarted by a rich industrialist.
McCall masquerades as a nightclub singer to investigate the disappearance of a rock music star.
The malicious leader of paramilitary neo-Nazis take Hunter and McCall captive while planning their next attack
Hunter goes to Australia to help solve a murder involving a former girlfriend who's been missing for 3 years.
Hunter falls in love with a beautiful professional killer who's connected to an arson case he's investigating.
McCall is charged with murder when the prime suspect in her dead detective husband's case is found dead.
Sergeant McCall poses as a fashion model to expose a burglary ring preying on wealthy businessmen.
Hunter and McCall pose as spouses to investigate the murder of a girl whose death exposes a Soviet plot.
A concert pianist is paralyzed by fear when a man jailed for her attempted murder is released from prison.
A musician helps search for the assailant of a pregnant woman being kept alive until she can give birth.

As doctors prepare to operate on McCall, Hunter races to find whoever is killing potential witnesses.

After the murder of a crime boss, Hunter and McCall face an ethical dilemma: arrest the killer or let him go.

Hunter and McCall spend a frightening night in a remote mansion with a family of murder suspects.

Hunter and McCall investigate the death of a reporter and uncover a plot involving a wealthy industrialist.
Suspicion arises when a Bel Air housewife refuses to identify the man who stole her million-dollar necklace.
Investigating the death of Hunter's former girlfriend - did she jump or was she pushed from a highrise window?
When Hunter investigates a drug ring, his ex-partner becomes a suspect in the murder of the dealers.
Detective Doyle helps investigate the real life murder of an actress-turned-prostitute who was cut in half.

A Colombian drug dealer is murdered, and police informant Sporty James becomes the prime suspect.
The investigation of the stabbing of a deaf man hinges on clues the man gave in sign language before he died.

Hunter investigates the missing money from an old bust that implicates the police in criminal activity.

The case of a teenager who mistakenly shot his parents during what he claimed was a home invasion.
